description: This file defines API routes for managing work orders in a manufacturing maintenance system, utilizing FastAPI with SQLAlchemy ORM models. It includes CRUD endpoints for work orders, tasks, parts, and outcomes, with dependencies for authentication and database sessions.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router class used to define API route groups for work orders, tasks, parts, and outcomes.

methods.name: list[WorkOrderOut] list_work_orders( equipment_id: int | None = Query(None, description="Filter by equipment id"), status_filter: str | None = Query(None, description="Filter by status"), assigned_to: int | None = Query(None, description="Filter by assignee user id"), limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=1000), db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list work orders with optional filters.

methods.name: WorkOrderOut get_work_order( work_order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific work order by its ID.

methods.name: WorkOrderOut create_work_order( payload: WorkOrderCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN", "ENGINEER")), )
methods.description: Creates a new work order, restricted to roles ADMIN and ENGINEER.

methods.name: WorkOrderOut update_work_order( work_order_id: int, payload: WorkOrderUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN", "ENGINEER")), )
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing work order, managing lifecycle timestamps, restricted to roles ADMIN and ENGINEER.

methods.name: list[WorkOrderTaskOut] list_tasks( work_order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Lists tasks associated with a specific work order.

methods.name: WorkOrderTaskOut create_task( work_order_id: int, payload: WorkOrderTaskCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN", "ENGINEER")), )
methods.description: Adds a new task to a work order, restricted to roles ADMIN and ENGINEER.

methods.name: WorkOrderTaskOut update_task( work_order_id: int, task_id: int, payload: WorkOrderTaskUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN", "ENGINEER")), )
methods.description: Updates a specific task within a work order, restricted to roles ADMIN and ENGINEER.

methods.name: list[WorkOrderPartOut] list_parts_usage( work_order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Lists parts used on a specific work order.

methods.name: WorkOrderPartOut use_part( work_order_id: int, payload: WorkOrderPartUseRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN", "ENGINEER")), )
methods.description: Records usage of a part in a work order, decrementing inventory, restricted to roles ADMIN and ENGINEER.

methods.name: WorkOrderOutcomeOut get_outcome( work_order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves outcome record for a work order if it exists.

methods.name: WorkOrderOutcomeOut record_outcome( work_order_id: int, payload: WorkOrderOutcomeCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN", "ENGINEER")), )
methods.description: Creates or updates an outcome record for a work order, calculating total cost from parts used, restricted to roles ADMIN and ENGINEER.
